newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus bourse mkt cap 1.081 bln pounds in May.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus bourse mkt cap 1.081 bln pounds in May.

text.p: The total market capitalisation of the Cyprus Stock Exchange was 1.081 billion pounds ($2.102 billion) in May against 1.136 billion in April, the bourse said in a monthly report.
The general price index reached a high of 78.12 points in May and a low of 74.88. The bourse trades 87 securities from 43 companies.
The Approved Investment Companies sector showed the biggest drop of 11.34 percent, against a decrease of 6.15 percent in manufacturers.

Banks accounted for 54.64 percent of total market capitalisation, the manufacturing sector 12.03 percent and the insurance sector 7.90 percent. The share of corporate bonds was 7.93 percent and that of government bonds, listed on the bourse in early May, was 1.96 percent.
The CSE report said the total value of transactions in the month reached 12 million pounds, with an average of 576,000 per trading session.
The banking sector contributed 53.25 percent of the total value traded.

Investors focused on the shares of the Bank of Cyprus (Holdings) which accounted for 25.35 percent of the total volume traded, followed by Hellenic Bank with 10.45 percent and Cyprus Popular Bank with 9.97 percent.
Bank of Cyprus was given permission in May to publish its prospectus for a 12,500.000 rights issue.

Cytrustees Investment Company submitted an application to issue 2 million new international shares. New investment company Dodoni Portfolio Investment Co. Ltd, announced plans to issue 4 million shares and 800,000 warrants.
An application for a new member of the exchange was submitted by Parma Brokerage Ltd, the CSE report said. ($=0.514 pounds)
